phone.notes:
1. Fixed Continue Watching syncing between phone and TV.
2. Added direct Wi-Fi sync so phone and TV share your progress even if cloud sync is blocked.
3. Rounded the corners on watchlist video thumbnails.
4. Changed the app version display to show only numbers.

tv.notes:
1. Fixed Continue Watching syncing between TV and phone.
2. Fixed watchlist videos so clicking one opens that movie or show instead of staying on the current page.
3. Moved the bottom home categories into one Browse Sections menu item so the home page loads faster and smoother.
4. Rounded the corners on watchlist video thumbnails.
5. Changed the app version display to show only numbers.
